cues.en: The thing that was decided on was having the block servers do RPCs to the meta servers because the meta server could encapsulate all the logic of all the database calls that it needs to do. cues.zh: 最终确定的方案是让块服务器对元服务器进行 RPC 调用，因为元服务器可以封装它需要执行的所有数据库调用的所有逻辑。这绝对是处理该问题最正确、最简单的方法，但可能不是最复杂的。第三个问题是，在这种情况下我们只有一个数据库。

cues.en: There's, again, a bunch of ways that you can handle this that are sort of the standard or right way to deal with it. You can shard it. You can partition it. And that just sort of let us avoid having to deal with these really complicated database scaling issues. So doing all those three things,
cues.zh: 同样，有很多方法可以处理这个问题，这些方法可以说是标准或正确的处理方式。你可以分片。你可以分区。但事实证明，添加 memcache 并缓存一切要容易得多，或者说不是缓存一切，而是开始缓存那些容易缓存的东西。这让我们得以避免处理这些非常复杂的数据库扩展问题。因此，通过这三项工作，

cues.en: we ended up with roughly this architecture at launch, where we added a bunch of meta servers and block servers, put a load balancer in front of the meta servers, and added a memcache tier. And the block servers now do RPCs to the load balancers. And so after this point, the base architecture has been pretty stable. The problems now are that there's still a bunch of things here that there's only one shape.
cues.zh: 我们在发布时大致形成了这样一种架构：我们添加了一堆元服务器和块服务器，在元服务器前面放置了一个负载均衡器，并添加了一个 memcache 层。现在，块服务器向负载均衡器发起 RPC 调用。因此，在此之后，基础架构一直非常稳定。现在的问题是，这里仍然有很多只有一种形态的东西。

cues.en: And we need to get them to be stacks like the others. So actually, our architecture today is basically the same, but with those things filled out. And there's a lot of other stuff that's going on. There's batch job running machines and stuff like that. But our fundamental architecture for providing sync hasn't changed since that time.
cues.zh: 我们需要让它们像其他组件一样成为栈。所以实际上，我们今天的架构基本没变，只是把那些东西填充完整了。还有很多其他事情在进行，比如批处理作业运行机器之类的。但自从那时以来，我们提供同步的基本架构并没有改变。

cues.en: Making all of these into stacks is actually relatively difficult. It looks easy on the slide. You just kind of add more. But in practice, it's actually very difficult. Every one of them, even memcache, which it's designed to just, you can just add more servers. The way we use it, because we have these really high consistency requirements, we had to modify the memcache library that we use.
cues.zh: 把所有这些变成栈实际上相当困难。幻灯片上看起来很简单，你只要多加一些就行。但在实践中，这实际上非常困难。每一个，甚至memcache，它设计上就是你可以直接添加更多服务器。我们使用它的方式，由于我们有非常高的 Consistency 要求，我们不得不修改我们使用的memcache库。

cues.en: because most memcache libraries, when the server they try to hit is unavailable, they just move on to the next one. This is great for availability, because if one memcache server dies, you just start using another one. But it's really bad for consistency, because one web server might think a memcache server is down, but another one thinks it's up. And so if you have any sort of complicated memcache protocols going on, your servers are going to be cross-talking and not seeing each other.
cues.zh: 因为大多数memcache库，当它们尝试访问的服务器不可用时，它们就直接转到下一个。这对可用性很好，因为如果一个memcache服务器挂了，你就开始用另一个。但这对一致性非常糟糕，因为一个web服务器可能认为某个memcache服务器down了，但另一个却认为它是up的。所以如果你有任何复杂的memcache协议在进行，你的服务器就会互相串话，看不到彼此。

cues.en: And you can get cache inconsistencies. So we had to modify the memcache library for that. The load balancing tier, again, is also supposed to be easy. But that's actually interesting that it's tough because we use Python. It seems like those two things are unrelated, using Python and having difficulty scaling your load balancing tier. But there's actually this feature.
cues.zh: 你可能会遇到缓存不一致。所以我们为此不得不修改memcache库。负载均衡层，同样，本来也应该很简单。但实际上有趣的是它很难，因为我们用Python。看起来这两件事不相关，用Python和负载均衡层难以扩展。但实际上有这个特性。

cues.en: of Python called the global interpreter lock, which means to your first approximation that you can only run one Python thread at a time. You can have multiple threads, but only one will be scheduled at a time mostly. Except for like, I mean, if one's doing IO, then another one can come in, but you can't actually get true parallelism that much. So what this means is that for each web server, we want there to be exactly one request at a time that
cues.zh: Python 有个全局解释器锁，粗略来说就是同一时间只能运行一个 Python 线程。你可以有多个线程，但大多数时候只有一个会被调度。除非，我是说，如果一个在做 IO，另一个就能进来，但你其实没法真正获得多少并行性。所以这意味着，对于每个 Web 服务器，我们希望同一时间恰好只有一个请求在

cues.en: Adding a second request makes each request only proceed at 60% of the speed as a single request happening. And that sort of 20% improvement in throughput is just not worth it to us. So we want our load balancing tier to respect this. When you have one load balancer, it's easy. It just has all the state in it, and you tell it only one connection per web server. But when you have multiple load balancers, you can't really tell them
cues.zh: 再加第二个请求，会让每个请求的速度只有单个请求时的 60%。而那种 20% 的吞吐量提升对我们来说根本不值得。所以我们希望负载均衡层能尊重这一点。当你只有一个负载均衡器时，这很简单。所有状态都在它里面，你告诉它每个 Web 服务器只允许一个连接。但当你有多个负载均衡器时，你就没法告诉它们

cues.en: to max out at one connection across the entire load balancing fleet. I mean, I guess you could, but there's no load balancing software out there that actually does this. So we had the option of either building our own load balancing software, and we could add that feature if we wanted to, or we could play some sort of complicated game, or we could allow just one load balancer to die and just lose a whole bunch of capacity.
cues.zh: 在整个负载均衡集群范围内最多只允许一个连接。我是说，理论上可以，但市面上没有哪个负载均衡软件真的这么做。所以我们有两个选择：要么自己写负载均衡软件，想加这个功能就加；要么玩某种复杂的把戏；要么就允许一个负载均衡器挂掉，直接损失一大片容量。

cues.en: We did for a little while. But the result we ended up with was every load balancer now has a pair, has a hot backup. So if the primary dies, it, within a few seconds, switches over to the backup. And this is done using some network level tricks. And so this does mean that we have twice as many load balancers as we use. But in terms of work involved, it let us get this high availability.
cues.zh: 我们确实这么做过一段时间。但最终的结果是，每个负载均衡器现在都有了一个配对，有了一个热备份。所以如果主节点挂了，它会在几秒内切换到备份。这是通过一些网络层面的技巧实现的。所以这确实意味着我们拥有的负载均衡器数量是我们实际使用的两倍。但就涉及的工作量而言，这让我们实现了高可用性。

cues.en: having foreign key constraints, same deal. But there are certain assumptions you can make about MySQL usage that are not at all obvious. cues.en: The NOT server tier was also interesting. I guess it wasn't so much in terms of how to evolve it.
